title: Workers' Compensation Recordkeeping and Reporting Guides (F212-222-000)
issuer: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries

passages.question: In which class does the Safety Manager, coded 4904 but working at the office and job sites, belong?
passages.excerpt: A division of a single worker's hours SHALL NOT be permitted between two standard exception classifications or between a standard exception classification and a basic business classification. Clerical Office - Class 4904 workers are defined as those individuals whose duties are confined to keeping the books or records of the employer, in or about the employer's premises. ... If any worker described above is exposed to any operative hazard of the business, their entire worker hours shall be assigned to the highest rated classification of work to which they are exposed.

passages.question: Which hours count for hourly and salaried workers, and which records support those hours?
passages.excerpt: Computing Worker Hours. Hourly Workers: Workers who receive an hourly wage. Actual hours. Includes overtime. Excludes holiday, vacation, and sick pay. Salaried Workers: Workers who receive a fixed wage each pay period. 160 hours per month = 480 hours per quarter or Actual hours. The same method must be used for all salaried workers. ... Time Record showing days worked and hours worked each day ... Daily and summary time records must show the applicable occupation and risk class.
